Bumble relaxes women-first messaging rule to boost user engagement

Dating app Bumble has relaxed its signature women-first messaging rule, allowing users to initiate conversations first. This change aims to boost user engagement and provide more flexibility on the platform. The company stated the move is part of ongoing efforts to enhance the user experience. Other dating apps are also reportedly exploring similar strategies to increase interaction.
